text.en: Retry one Visual Curator image while the batch runs. Image actions keep their selected source and the batch keeps its saved progress.
text.zh-CN: 视觉策展支持在批次运行时重试单张失败图片，换图、取消和应用规划只作用于选中的图片，并保留批次进度。

text.en: Choosing All in Visual Curator loads the remaining server image pages for browsing and shows progress while it loads.
text.zh-CN: 视觉策展的服务器图片列表点击「全部」后会加载剩余分页，并显示加载进度。
